Anika (eng-ml): Heads up — saw a ~20% p99 latency regression when switching Mistral-v0 int8 -> fp8 kernels on Dedicated (8xA100). Repro on a small perf suite. Anyone seen this before? :eyes:
Matt (eng-ml): What workload and sequence lengths? batch distribution?
Anika (eng-ml): Short repro: seq=512, streaming off, mix of chat.generate RPCs. Baseline (int8_kA) p50 32ms p99 120ms. fp8_kF p50 28ms p99 145ms. Throughput similar but p99 spikes. Quick microprofile below.
Anika (eng-ml): ```
model: mistral-v0
kernel: fp8_kF_v2
batching: dynamic
batch_size_dist: {1:0.6,2:0.25,4:0.1,8:0.05}
kv_cache: enabled
calib: per_channel_quant
hw: 8xA100
```
Matt (eng-ml): Any KV-cache metrics or spill logs?
perf-bot: kv_cache_hitrate=0.82 (fp8 run) vs 0.95 (int8 run). kv_spill_events increased during fp8_kF run.
Rui (eng-runtime): That p99 jump smells like a memory-layout interaction. FP8 kernels sometimes change tensor packing and cause extra KV copies or alignment padding — which can push some requests onto the slower KV-copy path. Can you toggle kv-prefetch / alignment settings?
Zoe (eng-ml): Also check calibration mode. Per-channel scaling for FP8 on some Mistral layers causes aggressive scaling on residuals and layernorm inputs; that can trigger slowpath dequant or extra float ops. Any slowpath counters?
Anika (eng-ml): Yes, slowpath counters rose. Snippet from runtime counters: 
```
counters:
  kv_spill_events: 134
  slowpath_dequant: 87
  kernel_swap_fallbacks: 12
```
Sanjay (eng-infra): Try two things: 1) force batching heuristic to prefer homogeneous batches (max_batch=4) to reduce padding, and 2) switch FP8 calibration to minmax instead of per-channel for a quick sanity check. Also try disabling kv_prefetch to see if that prevents partial-copy stalls.
Matt (eng-ml): If slowpath_dequant increases, p99 will jump. Recommend A/B with these configs and collect p50/p95/p99, kv_hitrate, slowpath_dequant. Suggest runs: (A) int8_kA baseline, (B) fp8_kF default, (C) fp8_kF calib=minmax, (D) fp8_kF + kv_prefetch=false.
Anika (eng-ml): Kicked off the four runs. perf-bot summary below.
perf-bot: RUN SUMMARY:
  int8_kA: p50=32ms, p95=68ms, p99=120ms, kv_hitrate=0.95, slowpath_dequant=14
  fp8_kF (default): p50=28ms, p95=80ms, p99=145ms, kv_hitrate=0.82, slowpath_dequant=87
  fp8_kF (calib=minmax): p50=29ms, p95=72ms, p99=128ms, kv_hitrate=0.90, slowpath_dequant=22
  fp8_kF (kv_prefetch=false): p50=30ms, p95=76ms, p99=130ms, kv_hitrate=0.92, slowpath_dequant=19
Zoe (eng-ml): Nice triage. Looks like switching calib from per_channel -> minmax recovers most of the p99 regression and reduces slowpath dequant. For mistral-v0 the per_channel fp8 profile seems prone to higher numeric range variance in certain attention blocks. We should add a model-specific recommendation: fp8+minmax for this variant.
Rui (eng-runtime): Agreed. On the runtime side we should also make kernel-selection aware of kv_hitrate regressions: if kv_hitrate < 0.9 AND slowpath_dequant increased >x5, prefer the int8_kA kernel or fp8 with minmax profile. Also consider a short-circuit that prefers kernels with tighter memory layout when small/heterogeneous batch distribution is dominant.
Sanjay (eng-infra): I'll open a canary rollout: add a kernel-selection rule and roll to 10% traffic for mistral-v0. Also adding a perf-harness regression test to assert slowpath_dequant delta between kernels is within threshold.
Anika (eng-ml): Filing a short RFC for model profile + runtime heuristic update: 
  - mistral-v0: fp8 default calib = minmax (instead of per_channel)
  - kernel-selection: kv_hitrate threshold -> prefer int8_kA or fp8_minmax variant
  - perf test: assert slowpath_dequant delta < 20 on CI harness
Anika (eng-ml): Leaving logs and configs in the perf bucket: s3://redwood-perf/mistral/v0/fp8-calib-triage/1967890123. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Matt (eng-ml): Great triage. Once canary is up, let's collect 1 day of production telemetry and revisit. Also add an automated alert when slowpath_dequant increases >50% for a kernel rollout.
Rui (eng-runtime): I'll prototype a lightweight runtime detector that emits a "kv_hitrate_drop" signal we can use in routing rules.
Zoe (eng-ml): We should also document the calibration caveat in the model catalog entry so future model-onboarding follows the pattern.
Sanjay (eng-infra): Will schedule the canary for tomorrow morning PDT and ping infra-oncall.
Anika (eng-ml): Thanks team. Follow-ups: RFC draft, canary, perf CI test.
